div.div:
① Route A: read the dependency graph and Dependabot alerts through the API (the alert advisories come from the GitHub Advisory Database)
② Route B: the 2 pilots call sbom-generate, which hands the SBOM to the aggregation job
③ Read the external feeds (KEV, EPSS, OSV)
④ Open an Issue for each finding that meets the condition
⑤ Append the run record to supply-chain-runs (it carries the previous record's hash)
⑥ The watchdog checks the freshness and the chain of the records
⑦ The maintainer's machine checks the Hub workflow list and the records (it also catches the watchdog stopping)
⑧ The aggregation job reads the approved VEX decisions
⑨ Renovate opens update PRs
⑩ A person matches the component register against the advisories (dashed)
Solid arrow: automatic flow. Dashed arrow or frame: a person's step, or optional and not enabled.

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
*1 The numbers are configured values
12, 6 hours, 8 hours, 3 and 7 days, 24 hours, 180 days and 10 per run are policy settings (as of 2026-11-17), not measurements.
